description: The design never measures the mechanism the hypothesis names.

inputs.label: Method
inputs.content:
H1: Adaptive charging slows capacity fade BECAUSE it limits lithium plating on the
anode.

Methodology: We cycle cells under the adaptive profile and measure remaining capacity
after 500 cycles. We compare against the fixed profile's remaining capacity. We do not
measure plating, anode potential, or any intermediate quantity. We run one
configuration.

signals.name: identifies that the proposed mechanism is never measured
states the design cannot test the hypothesis as stated
